description: Live geometry CPU preparation and native Skia raster texture creation; not GPU execution or displayed frame latency
allocationScope: Current JVM thread heap bytes only; excludes native allocations and other threads
retainedMemoryScope: Texture primitive arrays are exact payload counts; geometry cache accounting includes conservative object estimates; native raster payload excludes backend overhead and GPU copies
oracle: SHA-256 of width/height as little-endian int64 and canonical little-endian RGBA_F16 texture inputs, plus separate exact contour/uniform SHA-256
